༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstod chen dngos grub 'dod 'jo bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstod chen dngos grub 'dod 'jo bzhugs so/ /

na mo shrī kā la tsa kra ya/ phun tshogs dge legs dpag yas las bsgrubs zag med mi 'gyur bde ba che/ /brjod bral chos dbyings khang bzang mchog na sgrib bral phung po'i gzi 'bar zhing*/ /rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya chen po ma'i gar gyi rol/ /kun mkhyen mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas 'jam mgon bla mar gus phyag 'tshal/ /chos dbyings ngang las rgya chen chos 'byung du// 'byung ba lhun po pad zla nyi ma dang/ /sgra gcan steng du mi phyed srung 'khor nang*/ / rab mdzes khro gzhal med khang*/ /rin chen las grub thugs gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor| |re re'ang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bcas/ /lha mi'i 'byor pas nam yang mi bsgrun pa'i/ rgyan mang bye ba'i bkod pas spras la 'dud/ /thugs 'khor nang gi phyed du rdo rje'i 'phreng/ /ljang khus shes 'khor lo dang/ /de phyed rdor 'phreng sngon pos rab bskor ba'i/ /'dab brgyad pad ljang mdzes par bcas la 'dud| |de steng zla nyi sgra gcan dkyil 'khor la/ khyab bdag baiḍur mdog can rig byed zhal/ /phyag drug nyi ma'i dpung pa rgyal ba'i phyag /spyan zhabs ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /dbus sngo g.yas dmar g.yon dkar mgrin gsum ldan// rtsa zhal drag po mchel brtsig g.yas kyi zhal/ /dmar po chags bcas g.yon dkar zhi ba ste/ /rgyab zhal ser po ting 'dzin gnas la 'dud/ /thor cog sna tshogs rdo rje zla phyaid dang*/ mdzes rdo rje'i nor bu dang*/ rna rgyan 'gul rgyan ske rags gdub po dang*/ /dar dpyang stag lpags na bzas mdzes la 'dud// phrag dpung phyag rnams sngo dmar dkar ba yi/ /grangs mnyam mthe bong la sogs sor mo lnga/ /ser dkar dmar sngo ljang mdzes tshigs*/ sor gdub kyis mdzes nag dkar dmar la 'dud/ /g.yas kyi nag po'i phyag bzhis rdo rje dang// ral gri rtse gsum gri gug dmar po bzhis/ /me yi mda' dang rdo rje'i lcags kyu dang*| |sgra bcas ḍa ma ru dang tho ba 'dzin/

/dkar po bzhi yis 'khor lo mdung dang ni/ /dbyug phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon gyi nag po'i phyag bzhis dril bu phub| kha ṭāṃ rnam par rgyas dang thod pa 'dzin/ /dmar po bzhi yis gzhu dang rdo rje'i zhags/ /rin po che dang pad dkar 'dab brgya 'dzin/ / dkar pos dung dang me long lcags sgrogs dang*/ /tshangs mgo pad mas spras pa 'dzin la 'dud// shin tu 'gying pa'i g.yas rkyang gis bzhugs pa'i/ /zhabs g.yas dmar po'i 'og tu 'dod lha dmar/ /gdong cig lag bzhis me tog mda' lnga dang/ /gzhu zhags lcags kyu 'dzin pa mnan la 'dud/ /g.yon pa dkar pos drag po dkar po ni/ /gdong gcig mig gsum lag bzhis rtse gsum dang*/ /cang te'u thod pa kha ṭāṃ 'dzin pa mnan/ /zhabs gnyis dga' ma dbus mas bsten la 'dud// mdun nas rab mdzes gser mdog sna tshogs yum/ /g.yas bskaur ser dkar sngo dmar zhal bzhi dang/ /phyag brgyad phyag rgya lngas brgyan spyan gsum ldan| |rdor sems cod pan 'dzin pas 'khyud la 'dud/ de yang g.yas kyi phyag bzhis gri gug dang*/ /lcags kyu sgra bcas cang te'u bgrang phreng 'dzin/ / g.yon bzhis thod pa rdo rje'i zhags pa dang*/ /pad dkar 'dab brgyad rin chen 'dzin la 'dud/ /shar gyi 'dab mar nag mau bar ma nag/ nag dmar ser dkar zhal bzhi spyan gsum ldan/ /phyag brgyad g.yas bzhis spos snod tsan dan snod/ /gur gum snod dang ga bur gla rtsi'i snod/ /g.yon bzhis dril bu pad ma lha shing gi /me tog sna tshogs me tog 'phreng 'dzin 'dud/ /lho yi 'dab mar dmar mo 'bar ma dmar/ /dmar ser dkar sngo'i zhal bzhi sbyan gsum ldan// phyag brgyad g.yas bzhis mar me do shal dang*/ /cod pan gdub bu 'dzin zhing g.yon pa bzhis/ /gos dang ske rags rin chen rna rgyan dang/ rkang gdub 'dzin pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang gi 'dab mar dkar mo 'bar ma dkar/ /dkar nag dmar ser zhal bzhi spyan gsum ldan/ /phyag brgyad g.yas bzhis 'o ma chu mchog dang/

/sman dang chang snod g.yon bzhis 'dud rtsi'i snod/ /grub pa'i ro dang 'dud rtsi'i 'bras bu dang*/ /zas snod bsnams pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// nub kyi 'dab mar ser mo 'bar ma ser/ /ser dkar sngo dmar zhal bzhi sbyan gsum ldan/ /phyag brgyad g.yas bzhis dung dang gling bu dang*/ /nor bu ḍa ma ru 'dzin g.yon pa bzhis/ /rgyud mangs rnga dang sgra sgrogs mkhar ba dang/ /zangs dung 'dzin pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me mtshams nag mo 'bar 'dra'i du ba ma// phyag brgyad rnga yab nag pos rab mdzes shing*/ /bden bral dmar mo 'bar 'dra'i mig rgyu ma/ /rnga yab dmar po 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang ldan dkar mo 'bar 'dra'i mkha' snang ma/ /phyag brgyad rnga yab dkar pos rab mdzes shing*/ /rlung mtshams ser mo 'bar 'dra'i mar me ma/ /rnga yab ser po 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag pha rol phyin pa'i rang bzhin te/ kun kyang phyag rgya lngas brgyan rdor sems kyi/ /cod pan rab mdzes mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /dbang ldan srin po me rlung mtshams rnams su/ /dung dkar gaṇḍi dmar po nor bu nag /dpag bsam shing ser rdo rje bzhi la bdud/ /bder gshegs 'bar ma'i shar du don grub nag|nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can spyan gsum ldan/ /phyag drug g.yas kyi ral gri gri khug dang*/ /rtse gsum 'dzin cing g.yon pas phub dang ni/ /thod pa kha ṭāṃ ga ni dkar po 'dzin/ /spyan mas mdzes pa 'khyud pa de la 'dud/ /lhor ni rin 'byung dmar po dmar dkar dang*| |nag pa'i zhal can spyan gsum rab mdzes shing*/ /g.yas gsum me yi mda' dang lcags kyu dang*/ /sgra bcas ḍā ma ru 'dzin g.yon pas gzhu/ /rdo rje'i zhags pa rin chen cha dgu 'dzin/ /mā ma ki yis mdzes par 'khyud la 'dud// byang du snang mtha' dkar po dkar nag dang*/ /dmar ba'i zhal can spyan gsum rab mdzes shing*/ /g.yas gsum tho ba mdung dang rtse gsum ste/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gis pad dkar 'dab brgyad dang*/

/me long dang ni bgrang phreng rab tu 'dzin| |gos dkar mo yis mdzes par 'khyud la 'dud/ /nub tu rnam snang ser po ser dkar dang*/ /nag pa'i zhal can spyan gsum rab mdzes shing*// g.yas gsum phyag gis 'khor lo dbyug pa dang*/ /'jigs byed rdo rje g.yon pas dung dang ni/ /rdo rje'i lcags grogs sgra bcas dril bu 'dzin/ / sgrol mas mdzes par 'khyud pa de la bdud/ /kun kyang pad dkar nyi ma rdo rje yi/ gdan zhugs yum rnams pad ma'i gdan gyi 'khyud/ /sgrib bral phung por gyur dang de rnams kyi/ /g.yas g.yon ling tshe shar lho byang nub tu/ /rkang khrag gci ba bshang ba rnam dag pa'i/ /gnyis gnyis bum pa brgyad dang bcas la 'dud/ /me mtshams sgrol ma don grub lta bu ni/ /rnam snang gis 'khyud srin por gos dkar mo| |rin 'byung lta bu 'od dpag med kyis 'khyud/ /dbang ldan mā ma ki ni snang mtha' 'dra/ /rin 'byung gis 'khyud rlung mtshams sangs rgyas spyan/ /rnam snang lta bu don yod grub pas 'khyud/ /kun kyang pad ma dmar dang zla ba'i steng*// pad ma'i gdan gyis bzhugs la thabs rnams ni/ /rdo rje'i gdan gyis legs 'khyud rlung me dang*/ /chu sa'i sgrib bral gshegs ma bzhi la 'dud/ /shar sgo'i g.yas su mkha' snying don grub 'dra/ /lho sgo'i g.yas su sa snying rin 'byung 'dra// byang sgo'i g.yas su spyan gzigs snang mtha' 'dra/ /nub sgo'i g.yas su sgrib sel rnam snang 'dra/ /rim bzhin dri gzugs ro reg rdo rjes 'khyud/ /sna mig lce lus rnam par dag la 'dud/ /shar sgo'i g.yon du kun bzang sngon po dang*/ /lho sgo'i g.yon du phyag rdor ljang khu ni/ /sngo dmar dkar dang ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal| |g.yas gsum rdo rje gri gug dgra sta dang*/ /g.yon gsum dril bu thod pa tshangs mgo 'dzin/ /chos kyi dbyings dang sgra yi rdo rje 'khyud/ /yid dang rna ba rnam dag de kun kyang*/

/gshegs pa bzhi dang bzhugs tshul mtshungs la 'dud/ / me dang srin po dbang ldan rlung mtshams su/ /reg bya ro gzugs dri yi rdo rje ma// rang phyogs gshegs ma dang mtshungs rim bzhin du/ /sgrib sel spyan gzigs sa snying mkha' snying 'khyud/ /byang sgo'i g.yon du sgra yi rdo rje dang*/ /nub sgo'i g.yon du chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ /rim bzhin kun bzang phyag rdor dang mtshungs te| |phyag rdor kun bzang gis 'khyud de drug kyang*/ /rang rang skye mched rnam dag gshegs ma dang*/ /bzhugs tshul mtshungs par bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// shar lho byang nub sgo bzhir khro bo'i rgyal/ /shin tu stobs dang rmugs byed khengs byed dang*/ /rengs byed rnams ni rang phyogs gshegs pa 'dra/ /rim bzhin spyan ma lta bu'i rengs byed ma/ /mā ma ki 'dra'i khengs byed gos dkar lta'i/ /rmugs byed ma dang sgrol ma lta bu yi/ /rab brtson ma rnams kyis 'khyud rdo rje yi/ /ngag dang phyag zhabs zhal rnams dag la 'dud/ /steng du mi skyod dbang po gtsug tor can| |phyag rdor lta bu shin tu sngaun mos 'khyud/ /steng shar byang rnams pad dmar zla ba dang*/ /lho nub pad dkar nyi ma'i gdan rnams la/ /g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs g.yon brkyang khro mos 'khyud/ khro bo'i nyams rdzogs stobs lnga rnams la 'dud/ /steng 'og gnyis su byang sems dkar dmar ni/ /rnam dag rgyal dang rnam rgyal bum pa gnyis/ /sgo yi phyi rol 'dod yon snam bu la/ /shar lho byang nub steng dang 'og rnams su/ /dri ma phreng ma spos ma mar me ma/ /lha shos ma dang 'bras ma sgeg mo bzhad/ /rol mo gar ma glu ma 'dod ma ste/ /gnyis tshan phyogs mdog gzungs ma rnams la 'dud/ /gsung 'khor lha rnams shar du yi dwags steng*/ /pad ma dmar po'i lte bar tsartsa ka /dbang pos rab 'khyud 'dab mar 'jigs ma dang*/ /drag mo dus kyi mche ba me 'bar dong*/ /rlung shugs rab gtum drag spyan sna chen mo/

/dgu car nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi yis| |gri gug rtse gsum thod pa kha ṭaṃ 'dzin/ /spyan gsum ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me mtshams mkha' lding steng du pad dkar gyi/ /lte bar tshangs pas 'khyud pa'i khyab 'jug ma/ /'dab mar g.yang mo sgyu ma grags ma dang*/ / dpal mo rnam par rgyal ma dpal rgyal ma/ /rgyal byed ma dang dpal ldan 'khor lo can/ /dgu char nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi yis/ 'khor lo be con pad ma dung 'dzin cing*/ /spyan gsum ldan pa= gshin rje ma he'i steng du pad dmar gyi// lte bar drag pos 'khyud pa'i phag mo dang*/ /'dab mar keng rus ma dang dus mtshan ma/ /rab tu khros gdong dus lce gtsig ma dang*/ nag mo 'jigs rung ma dang gzugs ngan ma/ /dgu car dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi yis/ /dbyug pa ral gri lcags sgrogs phub 'dzin cing*/ /spyan gsum ldan pa rnams la= srin po rma bya'i steng du pad dkar gyi/ /lte bar bgegs kyis 'khyud pa'i gzhon nu ma| |'dab mar pad ma lus med gzhon nu ma/ /ri dwags bdag pos 'gro ma rin chen 'phreng*/ /mig bzang ma dang rul ma bzang mo ste/ / dgu car dmar mo zhal drug phyag bzhi yis/ /mdung thung lcags kyu rin chen zhags pa 'dzin// spyan gsum ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang du khyu mchog steng du pad dmar gyi/ /lte bar gshin rjes 'khyud pa'i drag mo dang*/ /'dab mar gau ri gaṃ ga rtag ma dang*/ /myur ma to ta la dang mtshon byed ma/ / dmar ser ma dang lha mo nag mo ste/ /dgu car dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi yis/ /rtse gsum cang te'u kha ṭāṃ sbrul 'dzin cing*/ /spyan gsum ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drag por seng ge'i steng du pad dkar gyi/ /lte bar gdong drug gis 'khyud dpal mo dang*| |'dab mar dpal ldan dkar mo zla ba'i ri/ /ri bong 'dzin mdong ngang mdog 'dzin ma dang*/ /pad dbang dkar mig dri med ri bong 'dzin/ /dgu car dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi yis/

/pad ma bgrang phreng pad ma rin chen 'dzin| |spyan gsum ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nub du glang po'i steng du pad dmar gyi/ /lte bar srin pos 'khyud pa'i dbang mo dang*/ /'dab mar rdo rje 'od dang rdo rje'i lus/ /gser ldan ur sī kra bī ri mo dang*/ /rambha zug rngu med dang shin tu sgrol/ /dgu car ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi yis/ /rdo rje mda' dang dril bu gzhu 'dzin cing*/ /spyan gsum ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo| |rlung mtshams ngang pa'i steng du pad dkar gyi/ /lte bar khyab 'jug gis 'khyud tshangs ma dang*/ /'dab mar sā pi ṭi dang pad ma'i mig /chu skyes can blo ngag gi dbang phyug ma/ /gā ya bri dang glog ma dran ma ste/ /dgu car ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi yis/ /pad ma tshangs dbyug spyi blugs snod 'dzin cing*/ /spyan gsum ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtso mo rnams ni 'khor lo'i bdag po la| |mngon phyogs yab yum gnyis ka sa ga'i stabs/ /'dab ma'i lha mo rnams ni rol pa yi/ /stabs kyis rang rang gtso mor phyogs la 'dud/ /phyi rol stegs bu'i shar gyi g.yas phyogs su/ /sgrol ma reg bya rdo rje tsartsi ka khyab 'jug ma dang rab brtson ma rnams las/ /skyes pa'i dbye 'dod ma dang gos 'dod ma// lus phrug 'dod ma mchil ma 'dor 'dod ma/ /skrod bar 'dod ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon du sngon mo lcags sgrog khyi gdong ma/ /bya rog gdong ma rnams las skyes pa yi/ /kun tu gdung 'dod reg 'dod yan lag kun/ /skyong 'dod lhag ma za 'dod rnams la 'dud/ /lho sgo'i g.yas su gos dkar ro rdo rje| |phag mo gzhon nu ma dang rmug byed ma/ /las skyes skyong 'dod zas 'dod dri ma 'dod/ /gar 'dod ma dang sgems 'dod ma la 'dud/ / g.yon du drag spyan khro gnyer can ma dang*/ /phag gdong bya rgod gdong ma las skyes pa'i/ / rgyugs 'dod 'gugs 'dod bshang gci zag par 'dod/

/g.yul ngo 'dod ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang sgo'i g.yas su mā ki gzugs rdo rje/ /drag mo dpal mo nga rgyal ma rnams las/ /skyes pa'i rgyas 'dod brgyan 'dod stan 'dod ma| |rgyal srid 'dod dang 'jam smra 'dod la 'dud/ /g.yon du sgra rdo rje dang tsunda dang*/ /stag gdong 'ug gdong ma rnams las skyes pa'i/ /rol mo 'dod dang 'ching 'dod rtsod mang 'dod/ /byis pa khro bar 'dod ma rnams la 'dud/ /nub sgo'i g.yas su spyan ma dri rdo rje/ /dbang mo tshangs ma rengs byin ma rnams las/ / skyes pa'i rengs 'dod dri 'dod mal stan 'dod/ /chu la rkyal 'dod smyan 'dod rnams la 'dud/ /g.yon du chos dbyings rdo rje 'od zer can/ /lce spyang gdong ma mkha' lding ma rnams las/ /skyes pa'i khrig 'dod phur bu 'debs par 'dod/ / sems can slu 'dod sbrul 'ching 'dod la 'dud/ /rdo rje dbyings phyug mas skyes gsod 'dod dang*/ /sna tshogs yum gyi bsgrubs pa'i skyed 'dod ma/ /kun gyi khyab byed kun kyang rang rang gi /skyed byed 'dra ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku 'khor lha rnams shar sgo'i g.yas phyogs su/ /yi dwags dmar po'i steng du pad dmar gyi/ /lte bar srin mos 'khyud pa'i bden bral la/ /rim gsum bzhi brgyad bcu drug 'dab mar ni/ /nya nyi rdo rje la sogs lha mos bskor/ /gtso 'khor nyer dgu mdog nag zhal gcig pa/ /phyag bzhi ral gri gri gug phug thod 'dzin| |spyan gsum nag pa zla ba'i tshes la 'dud/ /me mtshams ri dwags steng du pad dkar gyi/ /lte bar rab gtum mas 'khyud rlung lha la/ /'dab mar tsā' rtsi sogs bskor nyer dgu kun/ /mdog nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi dpag bsam shing*/ /yongs 'du'i me tog dbang sngon utpal 'dzin/ /spyan gsum sa ga zla ba'i tshes la 'dud/ /lho sgo'i g.yas su lug steng pad dmar gyi/

/lte bar chu lha mos 'khyud me lha la/ /'dab mar ṇa ṇi sogs bskor nyer dgu kun/ / mdog dmar zhal gcig phyag bzhi shaka ti dang*/ /dbyug pa dang ni padma spyi blugs 'dzin/ /spyan gsum snron gyi zla ba'i tshes la 'dud/ /srin por rma bya'-i steng du pad dkar gyi/ /lte bar dpal mos 'khyud pa'i gdong drug la/ /'dab mar ṭā ṭī sogs bskor nyer dgu kun/ /mdog dmar zhal drug phyag bzhi shakti dang*| |mdung dang rin po che dang me long 'dzin/ /spyan gsum chu stod zla ba'i tshes la 'dud/ /byang g.yas chu srin steng du pad dmar gyi/ /lte bar phag mos 'khyud pa'i rgya mtsho la/ /'dab mar ma mi sogs bskor nyer dgu kun/ /mdog dkar zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhags pa dang*/ /rin po che dang sbrul zhags chu shel 'dzin| |spyan gsum gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes la 'dud/ /drag por byi ba'i steng du pad dkar gyi/ /lte bar gzhon nu mas 'khyud tshogs bdag la/ /'dab mar pā pī sogs bskor nyer dgu kun/ /mdog dkar zhal gcig phyag bzhi dgra st+wa dang*| |rdo rje dang ni zhags pa rin chen 'dzin/ /spyan gsum khrums kyi zla ba'i tshes la 'dud/ /nub g.yas glang chen steng du pad dmar gyi/ /lte bar rlung lha mos 'khyud dbang po la/ /'dab mar na ni sogs bskor nyer dgu kun/ / mdog ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi rdo rje dang*/ /me yi mda' dang dril bu gzhu rnams 'dzin/ /spyan gsum tha skar zla ba'i tshes la 'dud/ /rlung mtshams ngang pa'i steng du pad dkar gyi/ /lte bar glog mas 'khyud pa'i tshangs pa la/ /'dab mar ṭa ṭī sogs bskor nyer dgu kun/ /mdog ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi khab dang ni/ /bgrang phreng pad ma ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin/ /spyan gsum smin drug zla ba'i tshes la 'dud/ /byang g.yon khyu mchog steng du pad dmar gyi/ /lte bar ri sras mas 'khyud drag po la/ /'dab mar ྈྐ ྈྐ sogs bskor nyer dgu kun/ / mdog sngo zhal gcig phyag bzhi rtse gsum dang*/

/mda' dang sbrul bcas kha ṭwāṃ gzhu rnams 'dzin/ /spyan gsum mgo yi zla ba'i tshes la 'dud/ /nub g.yon glang chen steng du pad dmar gyi/ /lte bar nor dbang mas 'khyud gnod sbyin la// 'dab mar sā sī sogs bskor nyer dgu kun/ /mdog sngo zhal gcig phyag bzhi nor bu dang*/ /be con ne'u le dang padma 'dzin/ /spyan gsum rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes la 'dud/ /shar g.yon mkha' lding steng du pad dmar gyi/ /lte bar dpal mos 'khyud pa'i khyab 'jug la/ /'dab mar nga ngi sogs bskor nyer dgu kun/ / mdog ljang zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'khor lo dang*/ /dbyug tho padma skye ba lnga dung 'dzin| |spyan gsum mchu yi zla ba'i tshes la 'dud/ /lho g.yon ma he'i steng du pad dmar gyi/ /lte bar gshin rje mas 'khyud gshin rje la/ /'dab mar kā kā+-i sogs bskor nyer dgu kun/ /mdog ljang zhal gcig phyag bzhi dbyug pa dang*// ral gri dang ni lcags sgrogs zhags pa 'dzin/ /spyan gsum dbo yi zla ba'i tshes la 'dud/ /gtso bo rnams ni 'khor lo'i bdag po la/ /mngon phyogs rdo rje gdan gyis yum la 'khyud/ /'dab ma'i lha mo rang rang gtso bo la/ /mngon phyogs rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs la 'dud/ /shar sgor phag bdun gyis drangs shing rta'i steng/ /dbyug pa sngon po mdog nag phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yas par ral gri rdo rje g.yon pa yis/ /phub dang sbrul 'dzin 'od zer can ma ser/ g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dbyug pa g.yon gnyis kyis/ /dung dang rin chen 'dzin pas 'khyud la 'dud/ /lho sgor rta bdun gyis drangs shing rta'i steng*/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po mdog dmar phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yas pas mda' dang lcags kyu g.yon pa yis| |gzhu dang zhags 'dzin tsun da dkar mo ni/ /g.yas gnyis tho ba mdung dang g.yon gnyis kyis/ /padma me long 'dzin pas 'khyud la 'dud/ /byang sgo seṅge bdun ldan shing rta'i steng*/ /tsunda lta bu'i mi g.yo mgon po la/

/'dod rgyal lta bu'i khro gnyer mas 'khyud 'dud/ /nub sgor glang chen bdun ldan shing rta'i steng*/ 'od zer can dang mtshungs pa'i stobs po che/ /dbyug sngon lta bu'i lcags sgrog mas 'khyud 'dud/ /steng du mkha' lding a ni'i shing rta'i steng*/ /gtsug tor can ni ljang khu phyag bzhi yi/ /g.yas kyis dgra st+wa rtse gsum g.yon sbrul zhags/ kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin shin tu sngon mo sngo/ /g.yas gnyis gri gug rdo rje g.yon gnyis kyis/ thod pa dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud la 'dud/ /'og tu seṅge rkang brgyad shing rta'i steng| |sngon mo dang 'dra'i gnod mdzes drag can ma/ /gtsug tor lta bus 'khyud pa thams cad kyang*/ /zhal gcig g.yas brkyang stabs la khro mo rnams/ / g.yon brkyang gis 'khyud gzhan yang phyi rol gyi/ kha khyer la gnas phyir 'dod tshogs la 'dud/ /rta babs ka ba'i 'og gi shar phyogs kyi/ /g.yonagayas rlung la padma stobs rgyu nag /lce spyang gdong dang mkha' lding mdong mas 'khyud/ /lho ru me la nor rgyas dung skyong dmar/ /stag mdong ma dang 'ug mdong ma yis 'khyud| |byang du chu la mtha' yas rigs ldan dkar/ /phag gdong ma dang bya rgod gdong mas 'khyud/ /nub tu sa la 'jog po pad chen ser/ khyi gdong ma dang bya rog gdong mas 'khyud/ /steng du mkha' la gdengs ka bdun ldan pas/ / rgyal ba ljang khu rdo rje mig mas 'khyud/ /'og tu ye shes la ni rnam par rgyal/ / sngon po gdengs ka bdun ldan sngon mos 'khyud/ /klu brgyad gdengs ka lnga ldan bcu char yang*/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi bum pa rdo rje dang*/ /padma rin chen bsnams zhing rdo rje yi/ /gdan gzhugs yum rnams padma'i gdan gyi 'khyud/ /rdo rje'i rkang sor rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me rlung khor yug mtshams su dur khrod brgyad| |shar sogs bskor tshul rim bzhin gnas pa ni/ /rtse mos 'bigs dang lhag ma za ba dang*/ /ro bsreg mi zad g.yul dang rul pa dang*/

/byis shi rnag dang sprul gyis zos pa yi/ /shar du bse yi steng du khyi mdong ma/ /me ru be ruṇḍa ster bya rog gdong*/ /nag mo 'jog po pad chen ser pos 'khyud/ /lho ru dom gyi steng du phag gdong dang*/ /srin po khrung khrung steng du bya rgod gdong*/ /dmar mo mtha' yas rigs ldan dkar pos 'khyud/ /byang du 'bri yi steng du stag gdong dang*| |drag por gshang gdong steng du 'ug gdong ma/ /dkar mo nor rgyas dung skyong dmar pos 'khyud/ /nub tu seṅge'i steng du lce spyang gdong*/ /rlung du mig sngon steng du mkha' lding ma/ /ser mo padma stobs rgyu nag pos 'khyud/ /rang rang gdan steng 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ /phyogs bzhi dmar dang mtshams bzhir dkar la bzhugs/ /sa 'og rkang brgyad shing rta rdo rje'i mig /sngon mo rgyal bas 'khyud dang nam mkhar ni/ /mkha' lding mdog lnga mig gsum shing rta'i steng*/ / sngon mo ljang khu rnam par rgyal bas 'khyud/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin/ /gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan mgo phreng 'phyang*/ /zlum po'i stabs bzhugs lag sor rnams la 'dud/ /dag pa'i ye shes gcig nyid gdul bya'i ngor| |'ja' tshon lta bur snang ba'i lha yi grangs/ /drug brgya sum cu rtsa drug mtshan ma dang*/ /bum bcas dkyil 'khor lha la gus phyag 'tshal/ /dur khrod phyi rol rlung gi khor yug la/ /zla nyi mig dmar lhag phur pa wa sangs/ /spen pa 'jug ring sgra gcan dus kyi me/ /brtan pa ri byi rgyu skar thams cad dang*/ /bcu gnyis khyim dang cha shas bcu drug dang*/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang dga' byed dbang phyug dang*/ /nag po chen po dril bu'i rna ba can/ /bhri gi ṇa dang zhing skyong pho nya mo| |'phrog ma bu bcas grub pa 'byung po'i tshogs/ /bye ba phyed dang bzhi yis bskor rnams dang*/ /rta babs so so la gnas lha mo'i tshogs/ kha khyer gzung ma'i tshogs dang bcas la 'dud/

/sku dkyil rta babs rtseg ma dang po yi/ /shar gyi dbus su chos 'khor nag po ni/ /g.yas g.yon ri dwags pho mos brgyan pa dang*| |lho ru bum dmar dung dang padmas brgyan/ /byang du rnga bo che dkar dbyug pa dang*/ /tho bas rab brgyan nub tu byang chub shing*/ /g.yas g.yon mi'am ci ni pho mos brgyan/ /thugs gsung sku dang ye shes ngo bor 'dud/ /zhing mchog bla med dang po'i sangs rgyas la/ /dngos bshams yid kyis gus par sprul pa yi/ / dag cing dri med yid 'ong chu bzhi dang*/ /rab mdzes yid 'phrog lha mo bcu gnyis dang*/ / nor bu dbang sngon la sogs bcu gsum dang*/ /phyi nang mchod bcu lus kyi dam tshig ni/ /so drug rin chen sna bdun bkra shis brgyad/ /bum pa 'dod 'jo nor bu 'dod yon lnga/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyur gyur 'dud rtsi dang*| |rnam gsum phyag rgya'i mchod pa bla med sogs/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos rtag tu mchod par gyi/ ma lus 'gro ba'i slad du bzhes su gsol/ /thogs med dus nas chags sdang gti mug gis/ /bgyis dang bgyid rtsal yid rang sdig pa'i tshogs/ /bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba/ /gang bgyis 'gyod pa'i sems kyis so sor bshags/ /bla ma'i thugs dkrugs de yi bka' la 'gongs| |spun la khros dang byams btang byams sems spangs/ /grub mtha' smad dang gsang byin phung po gzir/ /chos la ma dad sgyu yi byams pa dang*/ /ming sogs bral ba'i bder rtog gzhan skyon brjod/ /tshogs 'khor dam tshig spong dang bud med kun/ /smad bgyis rtsa ltung bcu bzhi sdom pa sogs/ yan lag dang bcas gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang sems 'phags tshogs kyi/ /dge dang dge gzhan kun la rjes yi rang*/ /nyon mongs nad gdungs skye bo gso phyir du/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bdud rtsi bstan du gsol| |ma rtogs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi dgongs pas/ /yun ring mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/

/sangs rgyas slob dpon des bstan chos mchog dang*| |der gnas dge 'dun gnyis la skyabs su mchi/ /yon gnas mchog la bdag nyid kun tu 'bul/ /brtse bas bran dang 'bangs su bzung du gsol| |bdag gi dus gsum dge ba ci mchis pa/ /rang don spangs te gzhan don kho nar bsngo/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub sems bskyed cing*/ /bdag dang bdag gi 'dzin pa spang bar bgyi/ / phyin drug tshogs gsum don du sgrub bgyi zhing*| |'gro 'di tshad med bzhi yis bskyang bar bgyi/ /bsdu dngos bzhi yis gzhan don sgrub bgyi zhing*/ /mi dge bcu dang sgrib pa lnga po dang*/ /nyon mongs bzhi dang zag pa bzhi po spang*/ /rnam thar sgo bzhis rdzogs byang bsgrub par bgyi| |rdo rje'i rigs la rdo rje dril bu dang*/ /phyag rgya bla ma spyi bos bsten par bgyi| |rin chen rigs la sbyin pa rnam bcu sbyin/ /rnam snang rigs la bza' srung dam tshig bsrung*/ /ral gri'i rigs la mchod pa kun sgrub cing*/ / padma'i rigs la tshangs spyod sdom pa srung*/ /rigs mchog rigs la stong nyid snying rje dang*| |dbyer med byang chub sems mchog sgom par bgyi/ /sna tshogs gtso bos legs par gsungs pa yi/ /sdig dang nye ba'i sdig lnga spang pa sogs/ /brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga rtag bsten cing*/ /drang nges dam tshig drug kyang rtag tu bsrung*| |de ltar snang stong sgyu ma'i rnam rol las/ khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas lha tshogs la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod dang sdig bshags yi rang sogs/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge dang rang gzhan gyi/ /dge tshogs ma lus gcig tu sdoms pa'i mthus/ nyam thag 'gro 'dis sdug bsngal kun spangs shing*/ /thun mong lam gyi rnam dag rgyud sbyangs te/ /lam mchog rdo rje theg par myur 'jug shog / zhugs nas lam gyi rtsa ba dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa mig gi 'bras bzhin bsrung byed cing*/ /lam gyi snying po zab gsal rim pa gnyis/

/legs par rtogs nas rtse gcig sgom par shog /tha mal snang zhen spros pa kun gcod cing*/ / rdzogs rim rtogs pa smin byed bla na med/ /rim pa dang po rtogs pa mthar phyin te| |zhi sogs phrin las rnam pa bcu gnyis dang*/ / grub chen brgyad sogs 'og min mthar thug pa'i/ /'jig rten pa yi dngos grub gang mchis pa/ de dag kun kyang mod la bde blag tu/ yid la bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub par shog / des kyang chog par mi 'dzin lam gyi mchog /mi 'gyur bde chen mngon du byed pa'i thabs/ /yid ches gsum ldan rdzogs pa'i rim pa che/ /ltos med bzhi dang ldan pas bsgom par shog /yul dang yul can 'brail gcod sor bsdud dang*/ / stong gzung yan lag kun ldan bsam gtan mchog / g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i rgyu 'joms srog rtsol dang*/ /'khor lor rlung kun brtan byed 'dzin pa dang*/ /snang ba dag pa'i gzugs 'dzin rjes dran dang*/ /mi 'gyur bde ba rtse gcig ting 'dzin te/ /thog mtha' bar dge bsnyen bsgrub bzhi ldan pa'i/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug po mthar phyin shog /mdor na rgyud sde spyi dang khyad par du/ /dus kyi 'khor lor gsungs pa'i lam gyi mchog /gzhal med legs par rtogs nas rtse gcig tu/ /sgrub la nam yang lhod par ma gyur cig/de tshe gnas skabs bzhi yi sgrib pa yis/ /bskyed pa'i phyi nang bdud bzhi'i bar chad kun/ /rdo rje bzhi yi ting 'dzin gyis bcom ste/ /myur du sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon 'gyur shog |dbang don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i/ /de nyid rnam pa bcu drug kun rig nas/ /'pho chen rnam pa bcu gnyis kyis bskyed pa'i/ /rten 'brel rnam pa bcu gnyis 'gag par shog /gal te tshe 'dir sangs rgyas ma thob na/ / 'chi tshe khyab bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis/ /bar dor 'od gsal dang ni rol mo'i sgras/ /bsus nas mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par shog /slar yang zab mo'i lam la 'bad pa yis/

/myur du 'pho ba'i bag chags kun spangs nas| |mi 'gyur bde ba che dang rnam kun gyi/ /mchog ldan stong nyid rtag tu rol bar shog /'dir 'bad legs byas ri dbang che lta bu/ /thub bstan spyi dang khyad par dus 'khor gyi/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i chos kun dar rgyas te/ /'gro kun phan bde'i dpal gyis 'byor bar shog / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bstod pa dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di'ang phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal zhing dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i rigs ldan shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos don du gnyer bas bskul ba'i ngor/ /don grub kyi lo snraun gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin bla ma'i lung gi brag phug rgod tshang gong mar sbyar ba shu bhaṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstod chen dngos grub 'dod 'jo/ -PAGE 306--PAGE 307--PAGE 300-
